title: canarium maluense f. lian
intro: Canarium maluense f. lian, commonly known as the Lian tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Burseraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, analgesic, and antipyretic activities, making it a potential remedy for pain relief, fever reduction, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Canarium maluense f. lian include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
